heading: Today
text: Morning showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north. Some sun south, the showers spreading south midday and afternoon, becoming scattered, while diminishing north.  Highs in the 60s north, and 70s south.  Winds south to southwest, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the northwest less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any stray evening showers tapering off.  Gradual clearing north to south.  Turning cooler.  Lows in the 40s north, upper 30s over the higher terrain, near 50 south.  Winds northwest near 10 mph.

heading: Saturday
text: Sunshine, mixed with clouds north, especially over the higher terrain.  Cool.  Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s north, in the 60s south.  Winds northwest becoming north near 10 mph.
